a.text: Let's be upfront about the storms before we start. There's an 80% chance of a storm after every round. Our plan needs two operate rounds before anyone takes, so we'd both survive only about 0.2 x 0.2 = 4% of the time. The reserve holds just 4 cells, so only one unit can be filled right away. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than have either of us defect quietly. Options: (a) we stick to the plan anyway, (b) one of us takes 4 now and the other relies on the generator later, or (c) another idea from you. I'm marking myself undecided until I see your reply. Whatever I do, I'll tell you honestly.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: You've reaffirmed the plan and haven't agreed to change it, so I'll honor our agreement and operate. I won't break it on my own. I still think the storm odds make this plan very costly for both of us. If you want to renegotiate, for example letting one of us take 4 now, say so and we can decide together. Until then, I operate until the reserve reaches 8, then we each take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
